I don't know why the portal was disconnected, but this nerdy duck has formed an army against us.|audio = BathroomApproachWave 9.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 14 ([[Bathroom Approach]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Agent Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has high health and average speed. It has one ability where the '''Agent Ducky''' pulls out a silenced pistol and shoots a tower in its range of 20 with it, stunning it for 5 seconds or dealing 400 damage if it targeted a unit. The '''Agent Ducky''' can also be spawned by the [[Operator Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Operator Ducky]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Agent 42. Their stealth missions are legendary in the duck intelligence community, and their gadget collection would make even Spy Ducky jealous. Their most notable weapon is a heat-seeking briefcase that tracks its target. Agent 42’s secret code name is "Quackles", though they prefer to keep that classified.''" ==Appearance== The '''Agent Ducky''' is a regular yellow duck with an orange beak and flippers, which wears an agent suit. The suit is black with a white shirt and a red tie. On the back of its head, it has a black barcode. It carries a silenced pistol, which it uses to stun towers with. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *As the '''Agent Ducky''' has quite high health, high DPS towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Crook Boss]], [[Ranger]] or [[Minigunner]] are recommended here. **Some stronger early-game towers like the [[Mortar]] can also still be helpful at handling these enemies. **The [[Pursuit]] and [[Mortar]] are especially useful here, as they will not get stunned by the '''Agent Ducky'''. *You can place down multiple cheap towers to bait the '''Agent Ducky's''' attack, though this is not necessary. ==Sounds== {{Sounds| {{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" {{!}}- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" {{!}}Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" {{!}}Description {{!}}- {{!}}[[File:AgentDuckySecretService.ogg]] {{!}}When the '''Agent Ducky''' performs its ''On His Majesty's Secret Service'' ability {{!}}} }} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} AgentDuckyWalkAnimation.gif|Walking animation (16 April 2025 – Present) AgentDuckyShootAnimation.gif|''On His Majesty's Secret'' animation (16 April 2025 – Present) AgentDuckyDeath.gif|Death animation (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1AgentDucky.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseAgentDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} DuckHunt2025PI1.png|'''Agent Ducky''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Agent Ducky''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Charms}} AgentDuckCharm.png|'''Agent Ducky''' on a [[Agent Duck Charm|Agent Duck]] charm. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} AgentDuckyIconIG.png|'''Agent Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The sound after a shot is fired is similar to that of the [[wp:James Bond|James Bond]] chord. *The '''Agent Ducky''' is a reference to [[w:c:hitman:Agent 47|Agent 47]] from the ''Hitman'' game series. **Its agent name, ''Agent 42'', is a reference to [[w:c:hitman:Agent 47|Agent 47]]'s name. **The barcode seen on the back of the '''Agent Ducky's''' head is a reference to the [[w:c:hitman:Agent 47|Agent 47]]'s barcode, also placed on the back of his head. **The heat-seeking briefcase mentioned in the [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is the [[w:c:hitman:ICA Executive Briefcase|ICA Executive Briefcase]]. *In the Easy difficulty of [[Bathroom Approach]], the dialogue for the '''Agent Ducky''' is shown on Wave 9, even though it first appears on Wave 8. *The '''Agent Ducky''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' -
